title: Access
items: What does the Access menu in the GUI maintain?
Who can log in, the access rights of users, and what each privileged user did
Access 選單管理誰可以登入、使用者的存取權限，以及追蹤特權使用者在系統上做了什麼。
What does an ownership group define?
A subset of users and objects within the system
A set of nodes in an I/O group
A group of pools with the same extent size
Ownership Group 定義系統內一部分使用者與物件，群組內使用者只能檢視與管理該群組的物件。
簡報 S3；Concept Guide Ch9 Ownership groups
What can unrestricted users (not in an ownership group) do?
View or manage all objects based on their role, including objects in ownership groups
Only manage objects not in any ownership group
Nothing until assigned to a group
不在 Ownership Group 內的 Unrestricted 使用者，仍可依角色檢視或管理所有物件，包含 Ownership Group 內的物件。
How many ownership groups can an owned object belong to?
一個物件只能屬於一個 Ownership Group。
Which object CANNOT be assigned to an ownership group?
MDisk 與 Drive 為全域資源，不能指派給 Ownership Group。
簡報 S3；Concept Guide Ch9 Configuring ownership groups
When a user group is assigned to an ownership group, what happens to its users' roles?
They retain their role but are restricted to resources in the same ownership group
使用者保留原本的角色，但只能存取同一 Ownership Group 內的資源，角色決定能做的操作、Ownership Group 再限制範圍。
Which role can create, manage, or assign ownership groups?
只有 Security Administrator 角色可以建立、管理或指派 Ownership Group。
From which object does a volume inherit its ownership group?
The child pool that provides capacity for the volume and its copies
The host it is mapped to
The volume group it belongs to
The user who created it only
Volume 繼承提供容量的 Child Pool 的 Ownership Group。
Does the ownership of a volume group affect the ownership of the volumes it contains?
Volume Group 的 Ownership 不影響其內 Volume 的 Ownership，兩者可分屬不同 Ownership Group。
How can volume groups be created according to the Access chapter?
Concept Guide 在 Ownership Group 說明中註明 Volume Group 只能透過 CLI 建立。
From which object do hosts that are part of a host cluster inherit ownership?
Host Cluster 內的 Host 繼承 Host Cluster 的 Ownership Group；變更 Host Cluster 的 Ownership 會自動變更所有成員。
If a host is removed from a host cluster that is in an ownership group, what ownership does the host have?
It inherits the ownership group of the host cluster it used to belong to
The ownership group of its first volume
從屬於 Ownership Group 的 Host Cluster 移除時，Host 會保留原 Host Cluster 的 Ownership Group；若原 Cluster 無群組則無 Ownership。
When can a host be added to a host cluster?
When the host and host cluster have the same ownership group
Only when neither has an ownership group
Host 與 Host Cluster 屬於相同 Ownership Group 時才能加入。
Can users with the Security Administrator role be assigned to an ownership group?
Security Administrator 角色的使用者不能被指派到 Ownership Group，User Group 在 Ownership Group 中也不能使用此角色。
When a restricted user creates a portset, which ownership group is it assigned to?
The same ownership group as that user
The ownership group of the first host
Ownership Group 內使用者建立的 Portset 會自動指派到該使用者的 Ownership Group。
Can users in an ownership group own storage portsets?
Ownership Group 內使用者不能擁有 Storage Portset，Security Administrator 也不能變更 Storage Portset 的 Ownership。
How many ownership groups can an LDAP remote user belong to?
Just one, associated with one of its user groups
LDAP 遠端使用者可屬於多個 User Group，但只能屬於其中一個 User Group 關聯的一個 Ownership Group。
From which objects do FlashCopy mappings inherit their ownership group?
Both volumes defined in the mapping
FlashCopy Mapping 繼承 Mapping 中兩個 Volume 的 Ownership Group；Consistency Group 的 Ownership 不影響其 Mapping。
When migrating to ownership groups, what is required for volumes used in a FlashCopy mapping?
Both volumes must be in the same ownership group
They must be in the same child pool
FlashCopy Mapping 涉及的兩個 Volume 必須在同一 Ownership Group，即使由不同 Child Pool 提供容量。
簡報 S5；Concept Guide Ch9 Migrating to ownership groups
Can mapping objects such as host mappings be assigned to an ownership group directly?
No; their ownership is determined by the related objects
Mapping 類物件不能直接指派，Ownership 依相關的 Host 或 Volume 決定。
Can users in an ownership group change the MDisk that provides capacity for their volume?
Only if it is an array
群組內使用者可變更群組內的 Volume，但不能變更提供容量的 MDisk 或 Drive 等全域資源。
Concept Guide Ch9 Configuring ownership groups
Can users in an ownership group view global resources such as drives?
Yes, they can view them but not change them
群組內使用者可以檢視全域資源，但不能檢視其他群組或無群組的資源。
When should system backup operations be run with ownership groups?
When objects are in a consistent ownership state
Only when ownership groups are disabled
為確保資訊完整，只在物件處於一致 Ownership 狀態時執行系統備份。
Concept Guide Ch9 Migrating to ownership groups
In migration scenario 1 where child pools exist, what happens when a child pool is assigned to an ownership group?
All volumes associated with the child pool automatically inherit its ownership group
Volumes must be reassigned one by one
Hosts automatically inherit it without prompt
現有 Child Pool 指派到 Ownership Group 後，其 Volume 自動繼承；GUI 會列出相依的 Host 供加入。
Where in the GUI do you create an ownership group?
於 Access > Ownership Groups 按 Create Ownership Group。
Concept Guide Ch9 Using the management GUI
Which field is unavailable when creating a data reduction child pool?
建立 Data Reduction Child Pool 時沒有 Capacity 欄位，它可無限制使用 Parent Pool 的可用容量。
How are roles defined in Storage Virtualize?
At the system level, so different systems can have different roles for a user
角色定義於系統層級，同一使用者在不同系統可有不同角色。
How many user groups can a local user belong to?
本機使用者只能屬於一個 User Group；遠端使用者可屬於多個。
By the local password file only
遠端使用者由 LDAP 驗證；單一登入需有對應的 User Group。
What can a local user add for CLI access in addition to a password?
A certificate from the IP quorum
本機使用者以帳號密碼登入，也可加入 SSH Key 供 CLI 使用。
At what level can multifactor authentication be enabled?
可按 User Group 啟用 Multifactor Authentication。
What can a user group control besides the role?
Which interfaces and functions are available, including scripting and Storage Insights access
User Group 可控制可用的介面與功能，包含腳本與 Storage Insights 等自動化存取。
What is the range for consecutive failed login attempts before automatic lockout?
自動鎖定可設定連續失敗 0 至 10 次，0 表示不鎖定。
What is the maximum lockout duration?
鎖定時間 0 至 10080 分鐘 (最長 7 天)，0 表示無限期鎖定。
Which command can a Security Administrator use to manually lock a user?
Security Administrator 可隨時以 `chuser -lock` 手動鎖定與解鎖使用者。
Can a Security Administrator manually lock their own account?
使用者不能手動鎖定自己的帳號。
Where are password policies, including lockout, configured in the GUI?
帳號鎖定等設定位於 Settings > Security > Password Policies。
The only local Security Administrator when the system is created
superuser 是系統建立時唯一的本機 Security Administrator。
What must be done on the first login to a new system?
新系統首次登入必須變更預設密碼。
Can the superuser account be deleted?
Yes, after creating another Security Administrator
Is the superuser subject to the account lockout policy by default?
superuser 預設不受鎖定政策約束；有專用 Technician Port 的系統可設定鎖定 superuser。
Which tasks can only the superuser perform?
Entering service mode, system recovery, and backup/restore of configuration
只有 superuser 能進入 Service Mode、執行 System Recovery 與 Backup/Restore Configuration。
What does the audit log record?
User actions submitted through management interfaces
Audit Log 記錄透過各管理介面提交的使用者動作，包括時間、使用者、來源 IP、Node 與參數。
Are passwords recorded in clear text in the audit log?
Audit Log 記錄指令參數，但不含明碼密碼。
Are failed commands recorded in the audit log?
No, only successful actions are recorded
Audit Log 只記錄成功的動作，失敗的指令不會記錄。
From which interfaces can audit log entries originate?
Audit Log 的來源可為 GUI、CLI 或 REST。
How does the GUI display the time of audit log entries?
Converted to the browser's local time
CLI 顯示系統時間；GUI 會轉換為瀏覽器的本地時間。
Where is the login message displayed?
Before login in the GUI, CLI, and Service Assistant
After login in the GUI only
Login Message 是登入前顯示的訊息，適用 GUI、CLI 與 Service Assistant。
Which command creates or changes the login message?
以 `chbanner` 指令或 Management GUI 建立與變更登入訊息。
Which role can view, create, and manage all portsets on the system?
A restricted user in any ownership group
Security Administrator 可檢視、建立與管理系統上所有 Portset，但不能把 Portset 指派給位於不同 Ownership Group 的 Host。
